# Ezra Chapter 10 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 470v–471r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/EZR_010_page_001.jpg

---

**10:1** And-when-Ezra prayed [ke-hitpallel] and-when-he-confessed [u-ke-hitvaddoto], weeping [bokheh] and-falling-down [mittnappel] before the-house of-God, there-gathered [niqqetsu] to-him from-Yisra'el an-assembly [qahal] very great [rav me'od] — men and-women and-children — for the-people wept [bakhu] with-great weeping [bekhi harbeh].

**10:2** And-answered [vaya'an] Shekhanyah son of-Yechi'el of-the-sons of-Elam, and-said to-Ezra, "We have-acted-unfaithfully [ma'alnu] against-our-God, and-have-settled [va-noshev] foreign [nokhriyyot] women from-the-peoples of-the-land; and-now there-is [yesh] hope [miqveh] for-Yisra'el concerning this.

**10:3** And-now let-us-cut [nikhrot] a-covenant [berit] with-our-God to-put-away [lehotsi] all the-wives and-those-born of-them [ha-nolad mehem], according-to-the-counsel [atsat] of-my-lord [Adonai] and-of-those-trembling [ha-charedim] at-the-commandment [be-mitsvat] of-our-God, and-according-to-the-Torah let-it-be-done [ye'aseh].

**10:4** Rise [qum], for upon-you [is] the-matter [ha-davar], and-we [are] with-you. Be-strong [chazaq] and-act [va'aseh]."

**10:5** And-rose Ezra and-made-swear [vayashba] the-chiefs of-the-priests, the-Levites, and-all Yisra'el, to-do according-to-this word, and-they-swore [vayishave'u].

**10:6** And-rose-up Ezra from-before the-house of-God and-went to-the-chamber [lishkat] of-Yehochanan son of-Elyashiv, and-he-went [vayyelekh] there. Bread [lechem] he-did-not-eat and-water [mayim] he-did-not-drink, for he-was-mourning [mitabbel] over-the-unfaithfulness [ma'al] of-the-exiles [ha-golah].

**10:7** And-they-caused-a-proclamation [vaya'aviru qol] to-pass through-Yehudah and-Yerushalayim to-all the-sons of-the-exile to-assemble [lehiqqahel] at-Yerushalayim.

**10:8** And-everyone who does-not-come within-three days according-to-the-counsel [atsat] of-the-leaders [ha-sarim] and-the-elders [ha-zqenim] — all his-property [rekhusho] shall-be-forfeited [yochoram], and-he himself shall-be-separated [yibbadel] from-the-assembly [qehal] of-the-exile.

**10:9** And-gathered [vayiqqavtsu] all the-men of-Yehudah and-Binyamin to-Yerushalayim within-the-three days. It [was] the-month the-ninth [ha-teshi'i] on-the-twentieth of-the-month. And-all the-people sat in-the-open-square [bi-rechov] of-the-house of-God, trembling [mar'idim] on-account-of the-matter [ha-davar] and-from-the-rains [ha-geshamim].

**10:10** And-rose Ezra the-priest and-said to-them, "You have-acted-unfaithfully [me'altem] and-have-settled foreign [nokhriyyot] women, to-add [lehosif] upon the-guilt [ashmat] of-Yisra'el.

**10:11** And-now give [tenu] confession [todah] to-YHWH the-God of-your-fathers, and-do [va'asu] his-will [retsono], and-separate [ve-hibbadelu] from-the-peoples of-the-land and-from the-foreign [nokhriyyot] women."

**10:12** And-answered all the-assembly [ha-qahal] and-said with-a-great voice [qol gadol], "Yes [ken]! According-to-your-word [ki-devarekha] upon-us to-do [la'asot].

**10:13** But [aval] the-people [are] many [rav], and-[it is] the-season of-rains [et geshamim], and-there-is-no power [ein ko'ach] to-stand outside [ba-chuts], and-the-work [ha-melakhah] [is] not for-one day or-two, for we-have-transgressed [hirbinu] greatly [leharbeh] in-this matter [ba-davar].

**10:14** Let-our-leaders [sareinu] stand [ya'amdu] for-all the-assembly, and-all who in-our-cities have-settled foreign women — let-them-come at-appointed-times [ittim mezummanim], and-with-them the-elders of-each-city [ir va-ir] and-its-judges [ve-shofteiha], until the-turning [hashiv] of-the-burning-anger [charon af] of-our-God from-us, concerning this matter."

**10:15** Only [akh] Yonatan son of-Asa'el and-Yachzeyah son of-Tiqvah stood [amdu] against this, and-Meshullam and-Shabbethai the-Levite supported-them [azarum].

**10:16** And-did-so [vaya'asu khen] the-sons of-the-exile, and-were-set-apart [vayibbadelu] Ezra the-priest [and] men [anashim], heads of-the-fathers [rashei ha-avot], according-to-the-house of-their-fathers, and-all-of-them by-names [be-shemot]; and-they-sat on-the-first day of-the-month the-tenth to-inquire [lidrosh] the-matter.

**10:17** And-they-finished [vayekhalu] with-all the-men who-had-settled foreign women by-the-first day of-the-month the-first.

**10:18** And-there-were-found [vayyimmatse'u] from-the-sons of-the-priests who-had-settled foreign women: from-the-sons of-Yeshua son of-Yotsadaq and-his-brothers — Ma'aseyah and-Eli'ezer and-Yariv and-Gedalyah.

**10:19** And-they-gave [vayitnu] their-hand [yadam] to-put-away [lehotsi] their-wives, and-being-guilty [va-ashemim] — a-ram of-the-flock [eil tson] for-their-guilt [ashmotam].

**10:20** And-from-the-sons of-Immer: Chanani and-Zevadyah.

**10:21** And-from-the-sons of-Charim: Ma'aseyah and-Eliyyah and-Shemayah and-Yechi'el and-Uzziyyah.

**10:22** And-from-the-sons of-Pashchur: Elyo'einai, Ma'aseyah, Yishma'el, Netan'el, Yozavad, and-El'asah.

**10:23** And-from-the-Levites: Yozavad and-Shim'i and-Qelayah (he [is] Qelita), Petachyah, Yehudah, and-Eli'ezer.

**10:24** And-from-the-singers: Elyashiv. And-from-the-gatekeepers: Shallum and-Telem and-Uri.

**10:25** And-from-Yisra'el: from-the-sons of-Par'osh — Ramyah and-Yizziyah and-Malkiyah and-Miyamin and-El'azar and-Malkiyah and-Benayah.

**10:26** And-from-the-sons of-Elam: Mattanyah, Zekharyah, and-Yechi'el, and-Avdi, and-Yeremot, and-Eliyyah.

**10:27** And-from-the-sons of-Zattu: Elyo'einai, Elyashiv, Mattanyah, and-Yeremot, and-Zavad, and-Aziza.

**10:28** And-from-the-sons of-Bevai: Yehochanan, Chananyah, Zabbai, Atlai.

**10:29** And-from-the-sons of-Bani: Meshullam, Mallukh, and-Adayah, Yashuv, and-She'al, and-Yeramot.

**10:30** And-from-the-sons of-Pachat-Mo'av: Adna and-Khelal, Benayah, Ma'aseyah, Mattanyah, Betsal'el, and-Binnui, and-Menassheh.

**10:31** And-the-sons of-Charim: Eli'ezer, Yishshiyah, Malkiyah, Shemayah, Shim'on,

**10:32** Binyamin, Mallukh, Shemaryah.

**10:33** From-the-sons of-Chashum: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zavad, Eliphelet, Yeremai, Menassheh, Shim'i.

**10:34** From-the-sons of-Bani: Ma'adai, Amram, and-U'el,

**10:35** Benayah, Bedeyah, Keluhi,

**10:36** Vanyah, Meremot, Elyashiv,

**10:37** Mattanyah, Mattenai, and-Ya'asav,

**10:38** and-Bani, and-Binnui, Shim'i,

**10:39** and-Shelemyah, and-Natan, and-Adayah,

**10:40** Makhnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,

**10:41** Azar'el, and-Shelemyahu, Shemaryah,

**10:42** Shallum, Amaryah, Yoseph.

**10:43** From-the-sons of-Nevo: Ye'i'el, Mattityah, Zavad, Zevina, Yaddai, and-Yo'el, Benayah.

**10:44** All these had-taken [nas'u] foreign [nokhriyyot] women, and-there-were among-them women who-had-borne [vayyasimu] children [banim].

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.2 — "there is hope":** The Hebrew *yesh miqveh* ("there is hope") is unexpected after so bleak a confession. Shecaniah reframes the crisis as solvable — the sin is grave, but repentance is possible. The word *miqveh* (hope, expectation) also carries a sense of "gathering" (as in a *mikveh*, a gathering of water), subtly evoking purification.

**v.3 — "to put away all the wives and those born of them":** The phrase *lehotsi kol nashim ve-ha-nolad mehem* is devastating in its scope — not only the foreign wives but their children are to be sent away. The text does not soften this, though the practical outcome remains historically debated.

**v.44 — Abrupt ending:** The book of Ezra ends with extraordinary abruptness. The final half-verse is textually difficult — *vayyasimu banim* may mean "and they produced/bore children" or may be corrupt. The Septuagint reads differently. The narrative continues, without formal closure, into Nehemiah.

*— EMET*
